data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
val i: Int = 1
val d: Double = 1.0
val b: Boolean = true
val s: String = "Text"
val opt: Option[String] = Some("Data")
data_types.notes: Use Option[T] (Some/None) instead of null for missing values.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
val sum = 1 + 2
val eq = 1 == 1
val bitwise = 1 & 2
operators.notes: Operators are just method calls in Scala (e.g., 1.+(2)).

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
val max = if a > b then a else b

x match
  case 1 => "One"
  case n if n < 10 => "Small"
  case _ => "Other"
conditionals.notes: Scala 3 supports optional braces and powerful pattern matching.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.code:
for i <- 1 to 5 do println(i)

val doubled = for x <- List(1, 2, 3) yield x * 2
for_loop.notes: For comprehensions can iterate and transform data with 'yield'.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Scala 3 uses 'do' instead of braces for while loops.

functions.title: Functions
functions.code:
def add(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b

val multiply = (a: Int, b: Int) => a * b
functions.notes: Functions can be defined with 'def' or as anonymous function values.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays use parentheses for indexing (calls apply/update methods).

maps.title: Maps
maps.code:
val m = Map("a" -> 1, "b" -> 2)
val v = m("a") // 1

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code:
import scala.util.{Try, Success, Failure}
val result = Try(10 / 0) match
  case Success(v) => v
  case Failure(e) => 0
error_handling.notes: Idiomatic error handling uses Try, Either, or Option instead of throwing.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Scala provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Scala supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Scala provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Scala converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Scala represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Scala formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Scala branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Scala defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Scala iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Scala organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Scala stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Scala groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Scala tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Scala organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
